Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error by repeatedly instructing the WebSurfer to acquire decision date confirmations, even after credible results already indicated the years in which both cases were decided (Reynolds v. Sims in 1964 and Selle v. Gibb in 1984). The excessive repetition of looking for exact decision dates was unnecessary, as the year difference between the cases was sufficient to determine the answer to the problem posed. This exhibits a pattern similar to Example 1, where there is a lack of consolidation of information already available and an inappropriate continuation of tasks to other agents without resolving the question at hand.
